name: FEMSA Foundation
program: Water Security (water and sanitation, ecosystem conservation, local capacity building; Latin America)
collect_note: FEMSA Foundation has no standing call list; it announces water calls (for example the BID-FEMSA innovation prize) as news in its noticias section, which the twice-daily run reads through the site's WordPress API and keeps only titles that announce a convocatoria and mention water, sanitation or hydric topics. Calls wait for review; the closing date is read from the Spanish phrase 'hasta el <day> de <month> de <year>' in the post.

sample.title: Convocatoria abierta: Premios BID-FEMSA 2024: Reconociendo la Innovación en Agua, Saneamiento y Residuos Sólidos en América Latina y el Caribe

evidence: Checked 2026-11-12. endpoint_recon on femsa.com foundation page found only the corporate /feed/ (10 corporate items, no calls) and no calls sitemap section. fundacionfemsa.org (foundation's own site): robots.txt HTTP 200, no calls page; /wp-json/wp/v2/types lists the custom type noticias; GET /wp-json/wp/v2/noticias?per_page=100 HTTP 200 returns 100 posts back to 2019. The only post that passes the filter is the 2024-08-05 'Convocatoria abierta: Premios BID-FEMSA 2024' (closing date 23 Aug 2024 stated in the post: 'hasta el 23 de agosto de 2024', prize USD 15,000), which the engine reads as closed. Other call-like posts ('llamado urgente ... Seguridad Hidrica 2030', 'Premio BID-FEMSA 2019', 'Convocatoria En Accion por la Primera Infancia') are commitment appeals, results or early-childhood calls and are filtered out on purpose. Zero open calls today.
zero_reason: No open water call today: the latest water call, 'Convocatoria abierta: Premios BID-FEMSA 2024', closed 23 Aug 2024 (https://fundacionfemsa.org/noticias/convocatoria-abierta-premios-bid-femsa-2024-reconociendo-la-innovacion-en-agua-saneamiento-y-residuos-solidos-en-america-latina-y-el-caribe/ : 'Los interesados pueden postularse hasta el 23 de agosto de 2024'); the filter passes that title, so it is tested against the last known call.
